{{Top}}
The '''PA-94 long-range phased tachyon detection array''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] device that was manufactured by [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]], and could be found aboard [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]], where it was integrated into the [[ANs-7e sensor unit]].<ref name="TSC">{{StoryCite|story=The Stele Chronicles|book=Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)}}</ref>
